remarks:
Northside Urban Oasis!! Discover this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 1.5 bath home nestled on a desirable corner lot in a prime neighborhood. Offering an abundance of character, comfort, and thoughtfully designed spaces, this home is truly a special find!

Step inside to a spacious kitchen featuring a center island, stainless steel appliances, perfect for cooking and gathering.  The home also offers a formal dining room, formal living room, and a bright Florida sunroom that provides additional space to relax and enjoy the seasons. A versatile bonus room offers  endless possibilities and could easily be a 4th bedroom, a nursery, home office or hobby space. 
The finished basement provides valuable additional living space, ideal for a rec room, exercise room, play room or media room.

Outside, you'll discover a private backyard oasis with lush landscaping, mature plantings, a fenced in vegetable garden, blueberry bushes and a  raspberry patch. Relax or entertain on the beautiful stamped concrete patio composite decking deck, or under the charming gazebo! The partially fenced-in back yard provides privacy and creates a peaceful retreat in the heart of the city.

Additional highlights include central air conditioning, a corner lot location, and a prime Northside neighborhood close to schools and amenities.  This home beautifully combines classic charm with comfortable modern living and exceptional outdoor spaces.  Don't miss the opportunity to make this urban oasis your own!
